columns.name: power_delta
columns.default:
CASE
    WHEN (opening_power IS NULL) THEN NULL::integer
    ELSE (closing_power - opening_power)
END

columns.name: item_level_delta
columns.default:
CASE
    WHEN (opening_item_level IS NULL) THEN NULL::integer
    ELSE (closing_item_level - opening_item_level)
END

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((granularity = 'DAY'::text) AND (opening_source_id IS NULL) AND (opening_observed_at IS NULL)) OR ((granularity = ANY (ARRAY['WEEK'::text, 'MONTH'::text])) AND (opening_source_id IS NOT NULL) AND (opening_observed_at IS NOT NULL))))
CHECK (((opening_observed_at IS NULL) OR (ROW(opening_observed_at, opening_source_id) <= ROW(closing_observed_at, closing_source_id))))

CHECK ((((granularity = 'DAY'::text) AND (period_end_exclusive = (period_start + 1))) OR ((granularity = 'WEEK'::text) AND ((EXTRACT(dow FROM period_start))::integer = 3) AND (period_end_exclusive = (period_start + 7))) OR ((granularity = 'MONTH'::text) AND ((EXTRACT(day FROM period_start))::integer = 1) AND (period_end_exclusive = ((period_start + '1 mon'::interval))::date))))
PRIMARY KEY (granularity, period_start, server_id, character_key, gear_type, week_start_hour)
